Europe Faces Fifth Summer Heatwave

Europe is bracing for its fifth summer heatwave, with temperatures expected to rise significantly this week. The heatwave is forecast to impact various regions across the continent. Details on the specific temperature ranges and geographical extent of the heatwave are being provided to the public. This marks a recurring pattern of extreme summer weather in Europe.
